payload.body: The 2x button doubles the live layout; on an empty layout it places the LAST settled bet doubled, not a plain rebet. Reason: playRound calls betLayout.clearAll() before settlement, so the felt is always empty when a player reaches for 2x after a round — the rebet-then-double reading would make 2x a duplicate of Rebet in the only state it is ever pressed from. An unaffordable double is refused outright and the button disables: never clamped, never partially applied, because a partial double silently changes which side the player is backing. Repeatable (4x, 8x) until the bankroll gate refuses. Keyboard X; order Clear -> Rebet -> 2x -> DEAL in both visual and tab order. Guarded twice — planDoubleWager checks the total, and betLayout.rebet() revalidates every chip and rolls back on refusal — so the over-wager hole from h7g4w2rg stays shut.
